source_system: Owner's email inbox; contracts folder

source_system: Owner's files

title: Site walk-through and equipment count
source_system: Blend room, raw-material room, warehouse and offices (observation)
what_it_shows: Inland light-industrial unit with one truck loading dock and no waterfront; 4 laptops, 2 desktops and 1 warehouse tablet counted; the tablet opened without a passcode; the HMI panel PC and the PLC control panel, with the cellular gateway inside it and its status lights on; hardwired emergency stop and T-1 high-temperature switch; atmospheric vents on both tanks; eyewash and shower; locked raw-material room with 2 hydrogen peroxide totes, one connected to the T-1 dosing pump; keypad entry, alarm panel and 4 cameras; no printed emergency call list at the blend room exit or the dock

title: Intake interviews: Owner and Operations Manager
source_system: Interviews (Owner and President, Operations Manager)
what_it_shows: The Owner keeps a paper formulation binder, updated quarterly; the Owner states the integrator gave no notice before switching on the AI feature; departing staff return keys and laptops, with no step for accounts, the HMI password or the door code; the HMI operator password and the door code were last changed in 2023; recipe and alarm limit changes are made on the HMI by the Operations Manager or the integrator with no approval or record; recipe files move between the HMI PC and the office on USB sticks; the MSP treats the HMI PC as the integrator's machine

title: Staff AI tool survey
source_system: Short questionnaire to all 7 employees
what_it_shows: The Operations Manager views AI recommendations on the portal dashboard; the QC Technician mentions the SDS service's drafting assistant; staff responses mention public generative AI chatbots; the survey did not record how many staff use them or what was entered; no list of approved AI tools exists in the documents provided

title: Vendor payments list, July 2025 to June 2026
source_system: Accounting and inventory service (SYS-07), payables
what_it_shows: Recurring payments to the MSP (including a resold backup subscription), the control system integrator, the productivity suite, accounting and inventory, SDS and label and payroll services, the alarm and video service, the internet and phone provider, the ERI provider, the insurers, LTL carriers and raw material suppliers; no charges from AI tool vendors

title: BIA interviews with process owners
source_system: Interviews (Owner, Operations Manager, Office Manager, QC Technician, Warehouse and Shipping Lead, MSP lead technician, integrator lead engineer)
what_it_shows: Each owner's description of their process, the systems, vendors and people it uses, its manual workaround, and the longest outage and data loss they say it can tolerate; about 85% of volume runs through T-1 and T-2; finished goods cover the top 40 SKUs for about 3 working days; pre-printed labels exist for the top 30 SKUs; a replacement panel PC can be bought in 2 days; the Operations Manager is the only person who runs the HMI's engineering functions

title: Risk assessment interviews
source_system: Interviews (all 7 employees, MSP lead technician, integrator lead engineer)
what_it_shows: Accounts of past events and near misses; the Office Manager handles bank detail changes received by email with no call-back; batches are finished before a forecast hurricane landfall by habit; laptops leave the site with the Owner and the Operations Manager; the MSP lead technician states its remote management console requires MFA, with no supporting evidence supplied

title: Account comparison, 2026-07-16
source_system: Suite, accounting, SDS and payroll user lists compared with the payroll roster (EV-001) and HR files (EV-002); accounting audit log
what_it_shows: One of the 5 accounting logins belonged to the temporary bookkeeper whose engagement ended in March 2026, about 4 months earlier; the accounting audit log shows no sign-in after the last day; the Office Manager disabled the login on 2026-07-16; the other SaaS accounts belong to current employees

title: Shared-drive sharing report, 2026-07-16
source_system: Productivity suite admin console (SYS-06)
what_it_shows: The formulations folder has an 'anyone with the link' share, created for the private-label customer

title: Site walkthrough, 2026-07-15
source_system: Blend room, offices and control panel (observation, with the Operations Manager, the MSP lead technician and the integrator lead engineer)
what_it_shows: Blend room staffed during batches behind keypad entry; control panel unlocked; HMI USB ports open; recipe USB sticks in a desk drawer; three connections traced: HMI PC to the office network (printing and file copies), HMI PC to the cellular gateway, and gateway to the integrator portal; small UPS (about 20 minutes) on the PLC and HMI and no generator; Top-Screen file and 2010 letter in a locked cabinet, access limited to the Owner, no electronic copy; release reporting numbers held only in the office phone system; RQ quantities in gallons not posted

title: Gap analysis interviews
source_system: Interviews (all 7 employees, MSP lead technician, integrator lead engineer)
what_it_shows: Owners' descriptions of how each RBPS 8 measure and DOT duty is carried out today. The Owner and the Operations Manager state that no one was assigned security for the batch control system; the integrator states it connects when it chooses under no written remote access rule, that the HMI remote desktop service uses a short password shared by integrator staff, and that the gateway administrator password is held only by the integrator; nobody tracks PLC, HMI or gateway advisories; the Operations Manager states the new Blend Operator has had no DOT training and is not under direct supervision for loading, and describes a 2025 attempt by an unknown walk-in buyer to buy hydrogen peroxide with cash, refused and not recorded; releases and fires are reported to 911, with no rule for reporting cyber incidents; integrator staff are not identified to the company by name

title: ERI provider SDS list comparison, 2026-07-20
source_system: ERI provider's SDS list compared with the SDS service (SYS-08)
what_it_shows: 83 of 85 SDSs held by the ERI provider match the current versions; 2 are older versions; the provider has not confirmed receipt of emailed updates

title: Personnel file review
source_system: Office Manager's HR files (personnel files for the 7 employees)
what_it_shows: Reference checks at hire on file; no criminal background checks on file

title: Security Coordinator designation letter
source_system: Owner's files
what_it_shows: Letter signed by the Owner on 2026-08-31 naming the Office Manager as Security Coordinator

title: AI-001 review: portal batch history and recommendation trials
source_system: Integrator portal batch history (2026-05-11 to 2026-08-14); safe-limit envelope of 2026-08-20; Operations Manager interview
what_it_shows: 160 T-1 batches reviewed; 7 recommendations proposed a heat-up setpoint above the recipe's written maximum, all for peroxide products, and none was adopted; the Operations Manager confirmed that the 2 batch tickets that did not match the HMI recipe in P07 testing were trials of AI-001 recommendations on a non-peroxide degreaser in June 2026, made without the Owner's approval

title: Integrator written answers on the AI feature
source_system: Email from the integrator lead engineer
what_it_shows: The integrator could not say what data the model was trained on or whether the portal vendor uses company data to train models for other customers, and could not supply the portal vendor's security report

title: Control assessment: remote access review
source_system: Integrator portal account page, session log (July 2026) and AI feature settings; HMI services list; gateway; Operations Manager and integrator lead engineer interviews
what_it_shows: No documented usage restrictions, connection requirements or guidance for integrator remote access; always-on cellular gateway; one shared portal login with MFA off; remote desktop service on the HMI PC with a short shared password; the July 2026 session log shows 14 integrator sessions, 9 outside business hours, none approved in advance, and the integrator says all were routine monitoring; the list of integrator staff using the shared login was not provided; the AI feature's write-back setting is off and can be changed from the shared login (screenshot 2026-08-11)

title: Control assessment: MFA sign-in tests
source_system: Sign-in attempts without a second factor to the integrator portal, accounting service, firewall management page and backup console (MSP present); suite and accounting MFA settings
what_it_shows: MFA enforced in the productivity suite for all users; the portal, the accounting service (3 of 4 users), the firewall management page and the backup console accepted a password alone

title: Control assessment: account management test
source_system: Suite, accounting, SDS, payroll, portal and HMI user lists compared with the staff roster; termination records; Office Manager and Operations Manager interviews
what_it_shows: Account types, procedures, approvals and reviews are not documented; the shared HMI operator login (with engineering rights) and the shared portal login are in use; SaaS accounts in place at assessment belong to current employees with a job need; the former bookkeeper's accounting login stayed active about 4 months until 2026-07-16; the shared HMI password and door code were not changed after the operator left on 2026-03-13; the integrator does not tell the company when its staff change

title: Control assessment: backup configuration review
source_system: MSP backup job report (July 2026), retention settings and vendor encryption documentation; USB recipe export log; integrator statement on its 2023 copy
what_it_shows: Suite and shared drive backed up daily with 30 days of versions, encrypted by the vendor, not immutable, and deletable by one MSP administrator login without MFA; policies, the SSP and the emergency action plan are in the backed-up shared drive; recipes exported monthly to one USB stick in a desk drawer; batch records on the HMI, the PLC program, the HMI project and the HMI PC image are not backed up by the company; the integrator's 2023 copy has no checksum

title: Control assessment: contingency test review
source_system: Restore test records (none); BIA; MSP lead technician and Operations Manager interviews
what_it_shows: No contingency plan test or restore test has been performed; the MSP and the integrator confirmed that no restore test record exists; no test criteria are defined

title: Control assessment: boundary protection test
source_system: Firewall rule export; port check of the HMI PC from an office laptop and from a laptop on the guest Wi-Fi; gateway placement
what_it_shows: The firewall blocks unsolicited inbound traffic and an external port check found no open services; firewall logs are kept by the MSP and not reviewed; the HMI PC's remote desktop service answered from an office laptop and from a laptop on the guest Wi-Fi; the guest Wi-Fi is not separated from internal devices; the cellular gateway connects the PLC and HMI to the internet outside the firewall

title: Control assessment: flaw remediation review
source_system: MSP patch report (July 2026); patch status on 3 office computers; HMI operating system and HMI software versions; PLC and gateway firmware versions from the integrator; MSP contract scope
what_it_shows: Office computers patched monthly per the July report; the HMI PC has had no update since 2023 and its operating system is past mainstream support; PLC and gateway firmware versions are not tracked; no one reports OT advisories to the company; no time limits or update testing are defined in the MSP contract or for the HMI

title: Control assessment: malicious code protection test
source_system: MSP antivirus console export; HMI PC; harmless antivirus test file on 1 office desktop; after-hours test alert
what_it_shows: Office computers update definitions automatically and run weekly and real-time scans; the test file was detected and quarantined; the HMI PC has no malicious code protection and USB sticks enter it unscanned; the after-hours test alert was not seen until the next morning; the company is not told of detections

title: Control assessment: configuration change control test
source_system: HMI audit trail setting; 10 batch tickets from June and July 2026 compared with the HMI recipes; Owner, Operations Manager and integrator interviews
what_it_shows: Types of controlled changes are not documented; recipe, setpoint and alarm limit changes are not reviewed, approved or recorded; the HMI audit trail is off; 2 of 10 sampled batch tickets did not match the recipe stored on the HMI, with no record of who changed it; QC had passed both batches

title: Control assessment: training records and staff interviews
source_system: DOT training binder; new-hire records; interviews with 5 of 7 employees
what_it_shows: DOT training every 3 years with a security awareness module (May 2024 cycle); no cyber, privacy or phishing training; the operator hired 2026-04-20 had no DOT security awareness record after the 90-day deadline; no awareness techniques or lessons learned in use

title: Control assessment: personnel termination review
source_system: Records for the operator who left on 2026-03-13 and the temporary bookkeeper who left in March 2026; door code and HMI password history; suite audit log
what_it_shows: No time limit for disabling access; the bookkeeper's accounting login stayed active about 4 months; the HMI password and door code the operator knew were not changed; no exit interview or confidentiality reminder; keys, the operator's key fob and the bookkeeper's laptop were returned; the bookkeeper's files were moved to the Office Manager's folder before the account was disabled

title: Control assessment: incident reporting interviews
source_system: Emergency action plan; office phone system contact list; interviews with 5 of 7 employees
what_it_shows: Staff know to call 911 for fires and releases; no time or channel is set for reporting cyber events; 3 of 5 staff interviewed would have restarted the HMI first; no recipients are defined for cyber incident reports; the release reporting call list exists only in the office phone system

title: Control assessment: external services review
source_system: MSP contract; integrator service agreement; SaaS terms; accounting vendor SOC 2 report; ERI contract; MSP questionnaire requested 2026-08-03
what_it_shows: The integrator and MSP contracts set no security or privacy requirements; the integrator switched on the AI feature without telling the company; roles are set for the MSP (contract scope) and the ERI provider (contract); no ongoing monitoring of providers; the MSP technician list and evidence of MFA on its remote management platform, requested 2026-08-03, were not received by fieldwork end
